laat_vaar.voor: Ons beskryf klimaat daarom per seisoen
laat_vaar.na: Daarom beskryf ons klimaat per seisoen
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Putting 'daarom' first links the sentence more naturally to the one before it.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A mid-sentence 'daarom' is natural Afrikaans and already links to the sentence before; fronting it is a lateral reorder.

laat_vaar.voor: Wes-Kaap rondom Kaapstad en langs die weskus noord daarvan is dit andersom
laat_vaar.na: Wes-Kaap, rondom Kaapstad en langs die weskus noord daarvan, is dit andersom
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Commas set off the place description so a Grade 5 reader can find where the long opening phrase ends and the main clause starts.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The commas turn two joined places (the south-west and the west coast north of it) into an apposition describing the south-west part, which moves the geography; the original parses correctly without them.

laat_vaar.voor: Die drie reënvalpatrone wys dus in watter soort gebied jou omgewing lê.
laat_vaar.na: Aan die drie reënvalpatrone sien jy dus in watter soort gebied jou omgewing lê.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A pattern does not 'wys' which area your surroundings lie in; 'aan ... sien jy' is the natural Afrikaans way to say you can tell it from them.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Die patrone wys' is acceptable Afrikaans and the proposal is longer for a Grade 5 reader without being clearly better; it is a lateral move.

vlae.teks: langs die weskus noord daarvan is dit andersom
vlae.rede: The protected-word reasons say the qualifier 'die meeste van' keeps the west-coast claim true because the far northern west coast is very dry with a less clear pattern; this sentence names the west coast north of Cape Town without that qualifier. Not changed, since adding it would change content; for a person or the writer to judge.
